# C4 Level 3 — Component Diagrams

This folder contains the output from the `/c4-component` skill.

## Contents (generated by agent)

One `.md` + `.drawio` pair per microservice:

| File Pattern | Description |
|--------------|-------------|
| `<service>-components.md` | Component diagram + Hexagonal architecture breakdown + OCPP sequence diagrams |
| `<service>-components.drawio` | draw.io XML for the component diagram |

Expected files (based on in-scope services):
- `ocpp-gateway-components.md` + `.drawio`
- `session-service-components.md` + `.drawio`
- `device-registry-components.md` + `.drawio`
- `authorization-service-components.md` + `.drawio`
- `billing-service-components.md` + `.drawio`
- `smart-charging-service-components.md` + `.drawio` _(if in scope)_
- `ocpi-gateway-components.md` + `.drawio`
- `notification-service-components.md` + `.drawio`

## Run `/c4-component` to generate these files (requires `/approve c4-container` first).
